## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] SDK or CLI
- [ ] Shared contract
- [ ] Build or release tooling
- [ ] License or legal documentation
- [ ] Private Chromium companion change

## Validation

List the exact commands, tests, browsers, and pages used to validate the change.

## Safety and licensing

- [ ] No private key, license key, API credential, customer data, or browser binary is included.
- [ ] New third-party material includes its required license and attribution.
- [ ] Public-contract changes are versioned and documented.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures contain no sensitive entitlement data.
